# Effect: limiter

Limiter: keeps output peaks below the ceiling to prevent clipping.

**Where to put it**: Only as the last effect on the master bus (master_effects).

Latest parameters: `muser effects limiter` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ceiling_db` | -0.3 | -24 – 0 dB | Output ceiling. -0.3 to -1 is typical |
| `release_ms` | 50 | 1 – 2000 ms | Release time. Short is louder but may distort; long is smoother |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "limiter", "ceiling_db": -0.5 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Regular mastering (safe)

  ```json
  {"type": "limiter", "ceiling_db": -1.0, "release_ms": 80}
  ```

- Louder (pop/electronic)

  ```json
  {"type": "limiter", "ceiling_db": -0.3, "release_ms": 50}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- Put it only as the last one in master_effects.
- A limiter only prevents clipping; it does not automatically make a piece sound good; pushing the input too hard squeezes the dynamics and distorts.
- To get louder, first raise master_gain_db or the makeup_db of the compressor in front, and let the limiter catch the peaks.
